text: The adjunction ♭ ⊣ ♯ in cohesive HoTT means:
choices: flat is left adjoint to sharp, so maps from a flat type to any type correspond to maps into the sharp type
sharp is left adjoint to flat
there are more flat types than sharp types
explanation: ♭ ⊣ ♯: Hom(♭A, B) ≅ Hom(A, ♯B). This expresses that ♭ collapses to discrete and ♯ enforces codiscrete cohesion; maps out of discrete types correspond to maps into codiscrete types.
